title: Derived realization from sheaf origin and exchange-step coherence
statement: Under exactly the finite discrete coefficient, field, square and constant-ring encoding assumptions in [lem-weil-pbc-finite-discrete-exchange-comparison], there are realization functors F0 on X and F1 on Y-prime such that F0 commutes with shifts, is full and triangulated, its essential image contains degree-zero single complexes of all constructible internal modules, and F0,F1 satisfy the three exchange-step comparison squares. Coefficients and exchange are those of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] and [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange].

proof.text: Obtain the monoidal constant-ring comparison by the finite clopen fibre cover.
Pull the point comparison to every scheme, including the multiplication, and supply this family to coefficient realization.
Use compatible coefficient equivalences with sheaf origin and step comparisons.
Apply exact derived realization and its single-complex API; all fullness, shift and triangulated instances come from the concrete functor.

theorem finiteDiscreteExchange_stepRealization [DiscreteTopology B] [Finite B]
    (hB : (ℓ : B) = 0) (sq : CommSq g' f' f g)
    (hEncoding : ∀ T : Scheme.{u},
      ∃ G : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) Ab.{u + 1})
          (Sheaf.sheafifyRingPresheaf.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
            ((Functor.const T.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj
              (RingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} B) : RingCat.{u + 1}))) ⥤
            Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} B)),
        G.IsEquivalence ∧ Nonempty (G ⋙
          sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
            (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} B)) Ab.{u + 1}) ≅
          Mod.forget (D := Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) Ab.{u + 1})
            (Sheaf.sheafifyRingPresheaf.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
              ((Functor.const T.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj
              (RingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} B) : RingCat.{u + 1}))))) :
    haveI : IsFinitenessCoefficient ℓ (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} B) :=
      .torsion B 1 (by rw [pow_one]; exact hB)
    ∃ F0 : FiniteDiscreteEtalePlus B X ⥤
        DerivedCategory (FiniteDiscreteInternalModules B X),
    ∃ cs : F0.CommShift ℤ,
      letI := cs
      F0.Full ∧ F0.IsTriangulated ∧
      (∀ M : FiniteDiscreteInternalModules B X,
        ProEtale.IsConstructibleModuleObject
          (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} B) X) M →
        F0.essImage ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)) ∧
      ∃ F1 : FiniteDiscreteEtalePlus B Y' ⥤
          DerivedCategory (FiniteDiscreteInternalModules B Y'),
      finiteDiscreteExchangeSteps B ℓ k sq F0 F1
